title: Verified landmark index tables and cross-convention correspondences

queue.claim: MediaPipe face_mesh_connections index sets and side naming: FACEMESH_LEFT_EYE ring = 263/466/388/387/386/385/384/398/362 + 249/390/373/374/380/381/382 (subject's left); RIGHT_IRIS = 469-472 with centre 468, LEFT_IRIS = 474-477 with centre 473; FACE_OVAL is the 36-point ring starting 10, 338, 297 ...

queue.claim: FLAME landmark embedding: static set of 51 barycentric points = iBUG 68 indices 17-67; dynamic 17-point jaw contour tabulated over 79 yaw bins clamped to +/-39 deg (DECA indexing: yaw>=0 -> round(yaw), yaw<0 -> 39 - round(yaw))
PeizhiYan/Mediapipe_2_Dlib_Landmarks is MIT-licensed and its 478->68 table agrees with the note's candidate map (e.g. jaw 127,234,93,132,58,172,136,149,152...; eyes 33,160,158,133,153,144)
queue.query: Mediapipe_2_Dlib_Landmarks mediapipe 478 to dlib 68 landmark index mapping
